subject: ClearFund: request for DR simulation artifacts and RPO/RTO substantiation
messages:
From: Sarah Ellis <sarah.ellis@clearfund.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearfund.com>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: artifacts from your DR simulation (SOC2 / SIG)

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for running the disaster recovery rehearsal with our team last week. As part of our SOC 2 evidence package and SIG review we need a few concrete artifacts and measured values from that test:

- The raw simulation logs for the failover window (including timestamps for primary cut, DNS switchover, and service readiness).
- RTO measurements at the service and API layer (per-service median and 95th percentile).
- RPO evidence for KV cache and persistent stores (snapshot timestamps + delta).
- A concise postmortem that lists what succeeded, what required manual remediation, and any follow-up actions.
- A signed witness list (who observed the live test).

If possible, please provide CSVs or short extracts we can attach to the SIG questionnaire. We will attach these to the SOC 2 evidence folder and share with our auditors.

Thanks — we need to lock these into our submission by EOD Friday (5/16). If some items will take longer, please call that out with an ETA.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Ellis
CISO, ClearFund

-----

Note: Procurement is cc'd for the official evidence folder and next steps on attestation.

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Ellis <sarah.ellis@clearfund.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: artifacts from your DR simulation (SOC2 / SIG)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list. We captured detailed telemetry during the rehearsal; I can assemble the artifacts you requested and upload to a secure folder. Planned deliverables and timeline below: 

- Raw logs and a trimmed tarball of the orchestration events (includes primary demote, target attach, and DNS change events) — will be uploaded by EOD Tuesday (5/13).
- RTO metrics: per-service median + p95 CSV and a short explainer of measurement methodology — EOD Tuesday (5/13).
- RPO: snapshot timestamps and the KV delta export (CSV) — EOD Wednesday (5/14).
- Postmortem (2-page PDF) including actions and owners — Thursday (5/15).
- Witness list: signed by on-call engineering and the ops lead — Thursday (5/15).

Attachments we'll provide as stubs in the upload: drr_simulation_log_20250512.tar.gz, kv_cache_delta_20250512.csv, dr_postmortem_20250515.pdf. If you need us to transfer via your SFTP or a specific secure location, send the upload instructions and we'll use that. Otherwise we'll place them in the secure drive link and grant you access.

Quick operational note: the rehearsal included a controlled cold-start failover from primary-us-west-2 to warm-standby-us-east-1 with simulated traffic replay. We used the same snapshot cadence that we run in production (30s snapshot frequency) so RPO should be bounded by that cadence — I'll include the precise deltas per shard.

Would you like a short walkthrough call when the artifacts are in the folder? Happy to run through the RTO/RPO numbers live.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none in this message (upload pending)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Ellis <sarah.ellis@clearfund.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 16:40:12 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: ClearFund DR artifact delivery — logs and measurements

Hi Sarah — uploading the artifacts now to the secure folder (link below). See the short summary and pointers to the specific files you asked for.

Summary (high level):
- Service layer RTO: median 47s, p95 112s (measured from primary failure injection timestamp to acceptance of health checks on target instances).
- API readiness RTO: median 59s, p95 138s (includes load balancer re-registration and traffic shaping).
- KV RPO: worst-case observed delta 28s across shards (snapshot cadence 30s; some in-flight writes were acknowledged before snapshot). We include per-shard timestamped deltas in kv_cache_delta_20250512.csv.
- Warm cache warmup: hit-rate reached 98% within 2m10s of failover start for the top-1000 keys (we include a short graph extract).
- Manual remediation steps: one minor IAM policy re-attach to the restore role (documented in the postmortem).

Attachments uploaded (stubs):
- drr_simulation_log_20250512.tar.gz (contains orchestration traces, instance boot logs, DNS change timestamps)
- kv_cache_delta_20250512.csv (per-shard snapshot timestamps and delta seconds)
- dr_postmortem_20250515.pdf (2-page postmortem with owners and action items)

Secure folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/secure/clearfund/DRR_20250512
Jira ticket with evidence: JIRA-DR-4921

Notes on measurement methodology (short): RTO measured from fault-injection timestamp to successful health-check pass on 3/3 replicas behind the LB. RPO measured as the difference between last acknowledged write timestamp on primary and last snapshot timestamp for each shard; we included the raw offsets in the CSV for auditor review.

If you'd like annotated CSVs (auditor-ready with column descriptions) I can produce them by Friday.

— Karthik
Solution Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachments: drr_simulation_log_20250512.tar.gz (tar.gz, 18.6MB), kv_cache_delta_20250512.csv (CSV, 48KB), dr_postmortem_20250515.pdf (PDF, 62KB)

Date: Sun, 18 May 2025 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearFund DR artifact delivery — logs and measurements

Hi Karthik / Mina — thanks, we've pulled the artifacts and started our internal review. A couple quick clarifying items for our auditors before we close the SOC 2 packet: 

1) Region coverage — were any parts of the simulation executed against non-us regions (apac/eu) or was it limited to us-west-2 -> us-east-1? Please confirm.
2) Key management — during the restore did you need to rotate any KMS keys or re-import any secrets into the keystore? If so, please describe the short procedure and timestamp(s).

If you can respond to those two points and attach a brief signed attestation (one paragraph, attested by your engineering manager) that the artifacts are complete and unaltered, we'll be able to close the evidence intake and move the SIG questionnaire forward.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Sarah
CISO, ClearFund
